create_moons_dataset: create a 2 moons dataset with configurable sample size, label swap probability, and random seed
generate_2d_grid: generate a 2D grid of coordinate points within a specified range for visualization
build_classification_plot_data: build a DataFrame of sampled classification predictions from an ENN experiment over a 2D grid
create_sample_plot: create a faceted tile plot of posterior samples from an ENN classification experiment
create_mean_plot: create a tile plot showing the posterior mean of ENN classification predictions over a 2D grid
